problem: The preservation guard hashed whole decision files. A legitimate append from #1158 made both the guard and its exported-tree rerun fail CI although the frozen8053f14e bytes were unchanged.

frozen_reference.measurement: Byte lengths and original digests were measured directly from the pinned Git blobs; source text was not printed. Runtime tests use fixed lengths/digests and need no Git object database.

before.guard_source: Unchanged d4253c8c wave3 and wave5 tests
failing_cases: Append to the original client decision
Current main decisions in a source export
before.negative_controls: Changing one byte at the start, middle or last byte of either original prefix was already rejected: six controls.

change.wave3: Retain the original8053 digests and add their original byte lengths. Require enough bytes, then hash only the frozen prefix. Appends pass; rewritten or truncated prefixes fail. No repin to current main.
change.wave5: This test delegates to the real wave3 guard and contains no duplicate digest. Its negative control now mutates a byte inside the frozen recipe prefix instead of treating an append as a rewrite.
change.new_regressions: Both append cases, six in-prefix byte mutations and the current main files run through the real guard in disposable exported trees without .git.

sources.mechanism: Existing frozen-public-byte preservation contract and original digests
Sequence slices and immutable byte sequences
SHA-256 over the selected byte sequence

source_boundary: Published CPython3.13.0 documentation supplies the stable bytes/hashlib semantics. The local unittest runtime is3.13.16; fetching the corresponding public documentation tag returned404, so no exact-patch-source claim is made.
execution: Checks run detached in an inherited native shell context, inside systemd-run --user --scope -p CPUWeight=idle --quiet, with separate log/exit files. The count-only runner suppresses assertion data and adds no skips.
required_before_commit: Run python3 scripts/validate.py after evidence registration; record its outcome and the committed-tip push gate in the PR body and lane coordination log.
scope: Two existing tests, one new regression module and this registered receipt. No decision document, installer, acceptance script or service configuration is changed. The separate two-P2 activation follow-up still waits for #1180's merge.
